parsed_json.up: Select molecule_chembl_id as compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles from molecule_dictionary join activities on molecule_dictionary.molregno = activities.molregno join assays on activities.assay_id = assays.assay_id join target_dictionary on assays.tid = target_dictionary.tid join compound_structures on molecule_dictionary.molregno = compound_structures.molregno where target_dictionary.tid = 5251 and assays.assay_organism = 'Homo sapiens' order by compound_chembl_id
